import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1_000_000_007L;
    static final int SIZE = 1 << 20;

    static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        long r = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long modInv(long x) {
        return modPow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int left, int right, boolean forward) {
        if (right - left <= 1) return;
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        fwt(a, left, mid, forward);
        fwt(a, mid, right, forward);
        int len = mid - left;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            int u = a[left + i];
            int v = a[mid + i];
            if (forward) {
                a[left + i] = u + v;
                if (a[left + i] >= MOD) a[left + i] -= MOD;
            } else {
                a[left + i] = u - v;
                if (a[left + i] < 0) a[left + i] += MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        int[][] p = new int[10][10]; // only first 6 rows used, but allocate extra

        long inv100 = modInv(100);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (int)((long)val * inv100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        // if n < 6, fill missing diagonal with 1 and set n to 6
        if (n < 6) {
            for (int i = n; i < 6; ++i) {
                p[i][i] = 1; // 1 % MOD = 1
            }
            n = 6;
        }

        // id mapping for all 6-bit masks with exactly 3 bits set
        int[] id = new int[64];
        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = idx++;
            }
        }

        int fullMask = 63;
        int[] X = new int[SIZE];
        int[] Y = new int[SIZE];

        long prob;
        int m1, m2, m3, mask, triple;

        // First section (rows 0,1,2)
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); ++i) {
            m1 = i & fullMask;
            m2 = (i >> 6) & fullMask;
            m3 = (i >> 12) & fullMask;
            prob = 1;
            for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
                int curMask = (r == 0 ? m1 : (r == 1 ? m2 : m3));
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (((curMask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        prob = prob * p[r][j] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[r][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            mask = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; ++a) {
                if (((m1 >> a) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; ++b) {
                        if (a != b && ((m2 >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; ++c) {
                                if (a != c && b != c && ((m3 >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                                    triple = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    mask |= 1 << id[triple];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            X[mask] = (int)((X[mask] + prob) % MOD);
        }

        // Second section (rows 3,4,5)
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); ++i) {
            m1 = i & fullMask;
            m2 = (i >> 6) & fullMask;
            m3 = (i >> 12) & fullMask;
            prob = 1;
            for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
                int curMask = (r == 0 ? m1 : (r == 1 ? m2 : m3));
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (((curMask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        prob = prob * p[r + 3][j] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[r + 3][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            mask = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; ++a) {
                if (((m1 >> a) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; ++b) {
                        if (a != b && ((m2 >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; ++c) {
                                if (a != c && b != c && ((m3 >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                                    triple = ((1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c)) ^ fullMask;
                                    mask |= 1 << id[triple];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Y[mask] = (int)((Y[mask] + prob) % MOD);
        }

        fwt(X, 0, SIZE, true);
        fwt(Y, 0, SIZE, true);
        for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; ++i) {
            X[i] = (int)((long)X[i] * Y[i] % MOD);
        }
        fwt(X, 0, SIZE, false);

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < SIZE; ++i) {
            ans += X[i];
            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
